agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Pure Power and Coba Berry were initially omitted from Meditite damage bounds.

resolution.observed: Shared damage mechanics and exact regressions now model both modifiers.

findings.summary: A faster Fake Out flinch was first labeled as a missing-PP execution failure, and spent enemy Fake Out remained legal after history verification failed.

resolution.observed: Flinch prevention and direct enemy Fake Out PP legality regressions pass.

findings.summary: Switch ranking allowed a teammate that survived only the entry hit, causing switch-spam pressure without a safe action window.

resolution.observed: Entry plus next-action survival/finish gates reject sacrificial matchup pivots.

findings.summary: Harmless Detect and Protect priority suppressed useful fresh-entry Fake Out and safe finishing moves.

resolution.observed: Priority comparisons now separate damaging replies from harmless status actions.

findings.summary: Vital Throw ROM priority decoded as +255 instead of signed -1.

resolution.observed: ROM priority uses a signed byte and the exact decode regression passes.

findings.summary: Charm missed critical-safety transitions, used a linear stage estimate, and tried to continue at the Attack floor.

resolution.observed: Exact stage ratios, critical race checks, and floor legality produced the verified three-Charm line.

findings.summary: Spark could paralyze an unstatused Guts attacker before its reply, turning a modeled safe hit into Ohmnomnom's avoidable faint.

resolution.observed: The exact state changed from Spark to Metal Claw; replay preserved Ohmnomnom and all regressions pass.

findings.summary: Step verification did not flag allied HP loss above the predicted critical ceiling.

resolution.observed: Battle steps now compare authoritative allied HP loss with the certificate critical bound.

findings.summary: Statused Facade power doubling was absent, and poison residual damage falsely looked like evidence that Sludge executed before Croakatoa fainted.

resolution.observed: The exact state changed to priority Vacuum Wave, KOed Machoke, and the verifier reported later pre-execution faints correctly.

findings.summary: Forced replacement menus scored the fainted active Pokémon and returned an illegal move instead of a legal party slot.

resolution.observed: Forced menus now return a legal ranked switch; this completed the live fight without manual selection.

findings.summary: Two-turn and finishing claims ignored higher-priority damaging replies such as Mach Punch.

resolution.observed: Both claims now reuse the damaging-priority comparator and dedicated regressions pass.

findings.summary: Forced-entry ranking preferred bulk before a guaranteed same-priority KO, exposing Coppertop to avoidable critical variance.

resolution.observed: Guaranteed KO before damaging reply is now the first forced-entry rank component; Black Belt is also modeled.

findings.summary: Coppertop was KOed by a Mach Punch critical while the model's pre-item critical range allowed that outcome.
Poison Touch, Leftovers, and several held-item effects were observed before their exact transitions were modeled.
Three successful consecutive Protects consumed attacks and let Leftovers erase progress; Protect-chain probability remains outside tactical ranking.
The accumulated classifier gaps and late forced-entry ranking caused five allied faints; this win was far less reliable than acceptable.

resolution.observed: Every identified action-changing cause is now in the shared v32 scorer/tooling with 343 passing tests; future hard fights remain gated behind clones.

findings.summary: Routine CLI step output repeated full movesets, PP arrays, and long feedback tails.

resolution.observed: Brief mode now keeps HP/status and 320 feedback characters; full output remains opt-in.

correct_choices: Three exact Charm uses reduced Machoke to the Attack floor before pivoting.
Fresh-entry Fake Out was repeatedly used for verified free tempo.
Metal Claw avoided activating Guts and preserved Ohmnomnom on replay.
Vacuum Wave corrected the Facade tie and delivered both priority finishes.
Lildozer's final Ice Shard was a verified minimax-visible KO before Mach Punch.
agent_review.next_test: Require v32 forced-entry KO ranking, legal forced-switch decisions, and compact output on the next trainer; Brawly remains blocked behind hard-fight preparation and three clean reviewed clones.
